lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Which property configuration are you looking for?
lines.hi: Aap kaunsi property configuration dekh rahe hain?
lines.hiTts: आप कौन सी प्रॉपर्टी कॉन्फ़िगरेशन देख रहे हैं?
lines.enTts: Which property configuration are you looking for?

lines.speaker: buyer
lines.en: I am looking for a 3 BHK apartment.
lines.hi: Main 3 BHK apartment dhoondh raha hoon.
lines.hiTts: मैं थ्री बी एच के अपार्टमेंट ढूंढ रहा हूँ।
lines.enTts: I am looking for a three B H K apartment.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: What is your preferred budget range?
lines.hi: Aapka preferred budget range kya hai?
lines.hiTts: आपका प्रेफ़र्ड बजट रेंज क्या है?
lines.enTts: What is your preferred budget range?

outcome.en: Budget captured. Configuration captured. Buyer qualification initiated.
outcome.hi: Budget captured. Configuration captured. Buyer qualification initiated.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Would you like to schedule a property visit?
lines.hi: Kya aap property visit schedule karna chahenge?
lines.hiTts: क्या आप प्रॉपर्टी विज़िट शेड्यूल करना चाहेंगे?
lines.enTts: Would you like to schedule a property visit?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.hi: Kya subah 11 baje aapke liye theek rahega?
lines.hiTts: क्या सुबह ग्यारह बजे आपके लिए ठीक रहेगा?
lines.enTts: Would eleven A M work for you?

outcome.en: Site visit requested for Saturday at 11 AM.
outcome.hi: Site visit requested for Saturday at 11 AM.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Are you still exploring property options?
lines.hi: Kya aap abhi bhi property options explore kar rahe hain?
lines.hiTts: क्या आप अभी भी प्रॉपर्टी ऑप्शंस एक्सप्लोर कर रहे हैं?
lines.enTts: Are you still exploring property options?

lines.speaker: buyer
lines.en: Yes, please share the project details.
lines.hi: Haan, please project details share kijiye.
lines.hiTts: हाँ, प्लीज़ प्रोजेक्ट डिटेल्स शेयर कीजिए।
lines.enTts: Yes, please share the project details.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I can arrange to send the brochure on WhatsApp.
lines.hi: Main brochure WhatsApp par bhejne ka arrangement kar sakti hoon.
lines.hiTts: मैं ब्रोशर व्हाट्सऐप पर भेजने का अरेंजमेंट कर सकती हूँ।
lines.enTts: I can arrange to send the brochure on WhatsApp.

outcome.en: Buyer re-engaged and brochure follow-up requested.
outcome.hi: Buyer re-engaged and brochure follow-up requested.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I am contacting you regarding your recent property enquiry. Is now a convenient time to speak?
lines.hi: Main aapki recent property enquiry ke baare mein call kar rahi hoon. Kya abhi baat karna convenient hai?
lines.hiTts: मैं आपकी रीसेंट प्रॉपर्टी इन्क्वायरी के बारे में कॉल कर रही हूँ। क्या अभी बात करना कन्वीनियंट है?
lines.enTts: I am contacting you regarding your recent property enquiry. Is now a convenient time to speak?

lines.speaker: buyer
lines.en: Yes, I would like to know the starting price.
lines.hi: Haan, mujhe starting price jaanna hai.
lines.hiTts: हाँ, मुझे स्टार्टिंग प्राइस जानना है।
lines.enTts: Yes, I would like to know the starting price.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I can check the approved project details and arrange further information.
lines.hi: Main approved project details check karke aage ki jaankari arrange kar sakti hoon.
lines.hiTts: मैं अप्रूव्ड प्रोजेक्ट डिटेल्स चेक करके आगे की जानकारी अरेंज कर सकती हूँ।
lines.enTts: I can check the approved project details and arrange further information.

outcome.en: New enquiry contacted and property information requested.
outcome.hi: New enquiry contacted and property information requested.
